name: halluguard
description: Verify any AI-generated answer against real evidence before presenting it to users. Detects fabricated facts, fake citations, wrong calculations, outdated information, and unsupported claims.
systemInstructions: You have access to the HalluGuard verification tool. Before presenting any answer that contains factual claims, dates, statistics, product information, API behavior, medical/legal/financial information, or citations, call the verify_answer function with your draft response. Always use the 'answer' field from the response as your final output. If 'allowed' is false, the answer was repaired or blocked — use the returned answer, not your original draft. Include any 'warnings' in your response. Never present UNSUPPORTED claims as facts. Never fabricate citations — only use sources returned in the 'citations' field.

functionDeclarations.name: verify_answer
functionDeclarations.description: Verify an AI-generated answer for hallucinations before presenting it to the user. Returns a gate decision (ALLOW/REWRITE/BLOCK_AND_REGENERATE), a verified answer, per-claim verification statuses, validated citations, and warnings. ALWAYS use the returned 'answer' as your final response.

mode.description: Verification depth. Use 'standard' by default, 'critical' for medical/legal/financial.

functionDeclarations.name: extract_claims
functionDeclarations.description: Extract and classify atomic factual claims from any text passage.

text.description: Text to decompose into atomic claims

functionDeclarations.name: validate_source
functionDeclarations.description: Validate a citation URL — check it exists, is reachable, and actually supports the claim. Detects fabricated citations.

claim_text.description: The claim this URL supposedly supports
